english: The Chinese are defeated and raise Manas as khan of Outer Beijing. [8]

english: There is no such heading in the original.

notes.manas-2010:p1372:b001:l004: Subject of жаадырбай is unstable after Almambet conjures weather; the following curse is directed at the marksman. Negative rain clause retained without inventing an explicit counter-spell.
notes.manas-2010:p1372:b001:l008: саадак тарт- means shoot/draw a bow in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/saadak/; the explicit gun in l011 is also retained, not harmonized away.
notes.manas-2010:p1372:b001:l013: Literal black-hat brim epithet retained. Exact Kyrgyz formula also occurs of Syrgak in Semetey1959 https://new.bizdin.kg/media/books/Семетей._1959_г..pdf (search text); no speculative steel-edge correction or ethnonym substitution.
notes.manas-2010:p1372:b001:l014: Printed parenthesis is embedded narrator verse; retained, not excluded as an editorial heading.
notes.manas-2010:p1372:b001:l018: Kerchunak is the struck marksman’s mount in context; ablative sequence does not transfer it to Syrgak.
notes.manas-2010:p1372:b001:l023: Жойболот treated as the named blade Zhoybolot in the weapon-swinging context; not silently harmonized to Achbolot.
notes.manas-2010:p1372:b001:l025: Detached nominative formula remains a fragment before the battle description; no invented predicate.
notes.manas-2010:p1372:b001:l034: Ылама is lama/preceptor, not an unverified personal name: local glossary1844:l002 gives chief/head teacher. Great Lama retained as a title throughout1372–1373.
notes.manas-2010:p1372:b001:l038: Күрөң describes the brown horse, named Kartküröng in1373:l008; the source variation is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1373:b001:l004: Stone worn as a rank badge, following shared lexical findings for the Chinese officials; no specific gemstone or rank invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1373:b001:l005: таза rendered finest in this champion-disguise context; literal pure/true is possible, not an assertion about ethnicity.
notes.manas-2010:p1373:b001:l008: Kartküröng belongs to the attacked lama here; Almambet remains on Sarala at l017.
notes.manas-2010:p1373:b001:l022: Kalmyk/Chinese speech imitation is the stratagem of the seized banner. Rattling and babbling retain the source’s disparaging sound description.
notes.manas-2010:p1373:b001:l026: темир тор literal iron net retained; whether a formation or concrete apparatus is not resolved.
notes.manas-2010:p1373:b001:l039: Sexist comparison of a fleeing enemy to a woman retained as source rhetoric.
notes.manas-2010:p1374:b001:l002: Unfinished conditional vow retained through l011; no invented concluding self-curse.
notes.manas-2010:p1374:b001:l007: Source possessive of troops is uncertain; the ensuing explicit army fixes the recipients, without changing the girls offered as war spoils.
notes.manas-2010:p1374:b001:l011: Literal measured by the whip retained. Distribution among riders is possible; exact counting or measuring procedure is unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p1374:b001:l025: Каканчын rendered the kakan, consistent with the Chinese ruler title in this project; not a newly invented person Kakanchyn.
notes.manas-2010:p1375:b001:l005: кул is a contemptuous fellow/wretch epithet here, not evidence that Kongurbay was legally enslaved.
notes.manas-2010:p1375:b001:l008: Unable to turn Algara’s head retained despite the subsequent flight; no silent directional repair.
notes.manas-2010:p1375:b001:l020: Kalcha remains Kongurbay’s established epithet, not a new fighter.
notes.manas-2010:p1375:b001:l036: This witness explicitly says swan wings and wild-ass hooves, not other body parts from parallel formulas.
notes.manas-2010:p1375:b001:l041: Angular and pointed haze description across l041–042 is literal; its exact topographic force remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1376:b001:l039: машаа gun hammer, attested horse-neck comparison https://el-sozduk.kg/маша/; not trigger or a place name.
notes.manas-2010:p1377:b001:l002: чаткаяк read as groin/space between hindlegs; tail-lashing retained literally.
notes.manas-2010:p1377:b001:l013: коргол dung pellet, contrasting weight of lead; not a euphemism or omission.
notes.manas-2010:p1377:b001:l015: Vertebra comparison preserved, though mechanically odd beside mountain weight; no silent replacement with a feather.
notes.manas-2010:p1377:b001:l040: Wings on the horse’s sides are explicit fantastic anatomy, repeated at1380:l007.
notes.manas-2010:p1378:b001:l008: түп этек literal bottom hem; grabbing the coat is contextual, not a confirmed lasso technique.
notes.manas-2010:p1378:b001:l024: Ар кескен treated as the blade-name Arkesken in the drawing/chopping sequence.
notes.manas-2010:p1378:b001:l031: Speech opening supplied from the explicit first-person worry in l034 onward; manuscript punctuation is defective.
notes.manas-2010:p1379:b001:l010: Star-moving formula retained without inventing an astrological identification or linking it to a new birth.
notes.manas-2010:p1379:b001:l013: көңүлү деп compressed construction tentatively rendered joined at heart in the oath-friendship context.
notes.manas-2010:p1379:b001:l024: Source calls the person threatened by divine punishment капыр/unbeliever despite Manas being the endangered Muslim hero. Apparent inconsistency retained; no silent captor/captive substitution.
notes.manas-2010:p1379:b001:l039: Source compares the wrenching action with a bereaved wife; gendered simile retained without assigning Almambet a literal husband.
notes.manas-2010:p1380:b001:l022: оорук is the army’s rear/baggage train. оорунтпайт rendered causes no trouble; subject rider/horse remains compressed.
notes.manas-2010:p1380:b001:l027: Sixty mature horse-years retained as epic hyperbole; no exact modern-age conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p1380:b001:l028: азуу equine tusk/canine metaphor retained, not an assertion about molars.
notes.manas-2010:p1380:b001:l030: Karabayyr is a horse designation; казанат battle steed, following established terminology.
notes.manas-2010:p1380:b001:l032: кайберен has sacred wild-animal/protector associations; spirit of wild beasts is provisional in this horse-origin formula.
notes.manas-2010:p1380:b001:l033: Twelve taken as Manas’s age because the following line says found for me; horse’s age is a possible alternative.
notes.manas-2010:p1380:b001:l036: Extraction жетнесе differs from image жетпесе. English follows the visibly printed negative, unless death comes; raw extraction retained unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1380:b001:l040: Source explicitly attributes Kökchebich to Chubak here, though Kögala is his mount later. No silent reassignment to Syrgak.
notes.manas-2010:p1381:b001:l028: бейпай trouble/torment, primary Kyrgyz dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/beypay/ and/beypay-4/; peril is contextual.
notes.manas-2010:p1381:b001:l031: Flood clause literally not entering the Chinese land retained as source mythic rhetoric, not historical fact.
notes.manas-2010:p1381:b001:l036: Causative and subject linkage across l036–037 is compressed: Manas struggles while Almambet brings him out. No extra action added.
notes.manas-2010:p1383:b003:l004: кан read khan in casualty registration, not blood; l005 explicitly counts the people.
notes.manas-2010:p1383:b003:l009: кошунум is irregular beside second-person жолдошуң; joined the army is a contextual reading, raw form retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1383:b003:l014: Contextually retranslated from the complete formula Ордолуу шайык көк жөкөр. Primary 1960 Semetey glossary PDF374 explicitly identifies it as an epithet of Kokand: great/holy/famous city and capital inhabited by many sheikhs. The complete formula, source image and adjacent Kyrgyz verses were individually reviewed; ordinary жөкөр dictionary footwear/retainer senses do not govern this geographic formula. Original raw text, IDs, coordinates and source lineation remain unchanged. Formula introduces Kokon/Margalang contingent in casualty count; collective city/people reference, not blue retinues.
notes.manas-2010:p1383:b003:l016: Printed жол/path retained; possible defective кол/army is not silently substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p1383:b003:l017: Two san and half a san at l020 retained as epic multitude units without fixed numerical conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p1383:b003:l027: Horse left behind/dead, rider alive is the casualty context; name surviving is a possible аты pun, not selected.
notes.manas-2010:p1383:b003:l034: Object fragment whoever came in front remains unresolved syntactically across next page’s troop-survey statement; all content retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1384:b001:l010: сырттан wolf-leader/hero; чунак affectionate dear one here, not a claim that his ears are missing.
notes.manas-2010:p1384:b001:l015: Manas’s lament is identified at l038; opening quotation supplied here where questioning begins.
notes.manas-2010:p1384:b001:l024: Kögala preserved as Chubak’s named steed; differs from Kökchebich attributed to him at1380:l040.
notes.manas-2010:p1385:b001:l012: Nearly swallowing the army read as terror-producing hyperbole; troops remain alive and speak in the following passage.
notes.manas-2010:p1385:b001:l024: san troop comparison retained as an epic unit; no invented modern headcount.
notes.manas-2010:p1385:b001:l033: Conditional vengeance oath left unfinished as printed; thousand and comparison to Chubak/Töshtük retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1386:b001:l002: кырылып кете таштады treated as fear hyperbole, all but struck dead, because this same army speaks and sleeps next; no invented actual second massacre.
notes.manas-2010:p1386:b001:l025: Fragmentary star clause retained; disappearance at dawn is suggested by context but not added as an explicit source verb.
notes.manas-2010:p1386:b001:l026: таң каракчысы means pre-dawn time in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/каракчы/; not a new watchman figure or star name.
notes.manas-2010:p1386:b001:l039: Two customary and two obligatory prayer cycles render суннот/парз in English; four-cycle dawn total exactly retained, not a correction of ritual.
notes.manas-2010:p1387:b001:l004: Амаз read namaz/prayer with initial consonant absent, consistent with subsequent recitation and closing greeting; raw preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1387:b001:l007: кан interpreted khan from the next explicit Ezkara title; blood remains an alternative literal parsing.
notes.manas-2010:p1387:b001:l008: Эзкара retained as Ezkara, source name variant, not silently replaced by Neskara.
notes.manas-2010:p1387:b001:l024: аппак whiteness epithet of the holy man retained; source does not explicitly give a white garment, and earlier calls his robe pied.
notes.manas-2010:p1387:b001:l033: Солтонум and Султаным are variants of the same sultan title; English repetition retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1388:b001:l026: Black tongue is an eloquence epithet, not proof of deceit: Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/til/ explicitly notes kara/k yzyl tongue epithets.
notes.manas-2010:p1388:b001:l036: кымын read tiny, related кымындай, in hair-small-life pleading formula; spelling retained raw.
notes.manas-2010:p1389:b001:l006: Marked/scored gate retained; ominous portent implied by speech but no invented writing or prophecy supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1389:b001:l009: санжыргалуу illustrious/authoritative, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/САНЖЫРГАЛУУ/; not a new epithet-name.
notes.manas-2010:p1389:b001:l025: Ay Jangjung retained as the established person’s name/title combination; not rendered as a new unnamed governor-general.
notes.manas-2010:p1389:b001:l026: уз skilled woman/craftswoman; no invented profession beyond skilled maiden in this bride-offer context.
notes.manas-2010:p1389:b001:l032: Шагымды is visibly printed, but no defensible primary Kyrgyz noun sense is established here. Surrounding ramparts and throne suggest a city/domain offer; dictionary шак branch/hope does not justify it. Whole verse retained raw and transliterated outside English count, with no silent шаарымды emendation. Completion-first first pass: Best-effort rendering from a close formulaic parallel; retain for specialist review because the source was previously unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p1389:b001:l033: Mounting the throne and enduring fame both retained from compact source; not a horse offer.
notes.manas-2010:p1390:b001:l015: бейжай unruly fellow, local glossary1835:l023–024; no unverified person Beyzhay.
notes.manas-2010:p1390:b001:l020: Subordination syntax read as people bowing to Ezkara after Karykan, as confirmed by the following Bakay-like authority description.
notes.manas-2010:p1391:b001:l003: Printed ablative Кытайдан irregular in war-against-Chinese clause; English contextual, raw retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1391:b001:l009: көөр precious stone, local glossary1839:l030 and Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/көөр/; not craftsmanship in this loot inventory.
notes.manas-2010:p1391:b001:l021: кара көк fearless/unyielding, Yudakhin көк III https://el-sozduk.kg/көк/; not black-blue skin.
notes.manas-2010:p1391:b001:l034: Suuk-Tör treated as the printed place name; өрдөшкө rising ground/uphill direction is provisional morphology.
notes.manas-2010:p1391:b001:l042: Closing fragment continues into next batch; no invented completion.
